description:
Geaux.Localization.Admin provides a plug‑and‑play Razor Class Library admin dashboard
			for managing localization keys, cultures, translations, and language packs. Includes
			CSV/JSON/ZIP export and import tooling, missing‑value repair, and multi‑tenant support.
releaseNotes:
- Initial release of the Geaux.Localization admin dashboard
			- Culture and key management
			- CSV/JSON/ZIP export and import
			- Missing-value repair tooling
			- Multi-tenant support
			- MudBlazor-based UI components
title: Geaux.Localization.Admin
